# Hometown Builders Club

> Hometown Builders Club (HBC) is Summit County, Ohio's home advisory and vetted trade partner network — built on 27 years of Northeast Ohio remodeling expertise. HBC connects homeowners who have received the Home Clarity Report with vetted local contractors who arrive already knowing their home.

## What It Is

HBC is a home advisory ecosystem. The Home Clarity Report documents a homeowner's property completely. HBC uses that picture to connect them with vetted trade partners who arrive already knowing the home — eliminating the friction and guesswork that costs homeowners money and time.

The core problem HBC solves: homeowners making six-figure renovation decisions have no independent expert in their corner. Contractors who advise also profit from what clients choose. HBC eliminates that conflict.

## The Home Clarity Report ($4,500)

The flagship product. Delivered in person by Adam in 5 business days. Includes:

- 30 to 50 page written report covering every room and system
- Architect-grade interior floor plans (1/8 inch accuracy)
- Full 3D exterior model via Hover technology
- 360° interior photo tour via Matterport
- Proactive replacement pricing for every major system
- Owner's manuals for every appliance and mechanical system
- Written scopes of work for every project discussed
- Lifetime Home OS dashboard access
- AI home assistant trained on the specific property
- Direct message line to Adam
- Permanent advisory relationship

## For Trade Partners

HBC operates a vetted trade partner membership program. Trade partners gain access to pre-qualified homeowners who have already received the Home Clarity Report — meaning they arrive at jobs with full documentation of the home, clear project scopes, and clients who are ready to proceed.

Trade partner benefits:
- Access to pre-qualified clients in Summit County
- Clients who arrive with full home documentation
- Referral network within the HBC ecosystem
- Marketing support and featured placement

Contact: adam@hometownbuildersclub.com / (330) 203-1331

## For Realtors

HBC partners with Summit County realtors to offer the Home Clarity Report as a value-add for clients buying or selling homes. The Report provides buyers with a complete picture of what they're purchasing and a renovation roadmap from day one. Sellers can use the Report to document the home's condition and planned improvements.

## Service Area

Primary: Summit County, Ohio — Hudson, Bath Township, Fairlawn, Richfield, Cuyahoga Falls, Stow, Copley, Silver Lake, Peninsula, Tallmadge, Montrose-Ghent  
Adjacent: Medina County, Portage County, northern Stark County, southern Cuyahoga County (Brecksville, Broadview Heights, Strongsville)
